interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Convert the painted median into a raised concrete refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Pave the existing gap in the sidewalk to provide a continuous, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Curb and Driveway Definition
interventions.description: Install a continuous curb with a single, defined driveway entrance to the store to limit vehicle crossing points and protect the pedestrian zone.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer
